gain.en: Students can gain confidence by practicing short presentations regularly.
gain.zh: 學生可以透過規律練習短講來建立自信。

game.en: The final game attracted a large crowd to the stadium.
game.zh: 決賽吸引大批觀眾到體育場。

gap.en: The study found a clear gap between the two groups.
gap.zh: 這項研究發現兩組之間有明顯差距。

garage.en: The bicycles are stored in the garage behind the house.
garage.zh: 腳踏車存放在房子後方的車庫裡。

garden.en: Students planted herbs in a small garden beside the classroom.
garden.zh: 學生在教室旁的小花園種了香草。

gas.en: The experiment measures how quickly the gas expands when heated.
gas.zh: 這個實驗測量氣體受熱時膨脹的速度。

gate.en: The school gate opens at seven every morning.
gate.zh: 校門每天早上七點開啟。

gather.en: We gather information from several sources before writing the report.
gather.zh: 我們在寫報告前會從多個來源蒐集資訊。

general.en: The teacher gave a general overview before discussing the details.
general.zh: 老師先做整體概述，再討論細節。

generally.en: Students generally perform better when they sleep enough before exams.
generally.zh: 學生在考前睡眠充足時，通常表現得更好。

generate.en: Solar panels generate electricity by using energy from sunlight.
generate.zh: 太陽能板利用陽光產生電力。

generation.en: Each generation develops its own habits for using technology.
generation.zh: 每一代人都會形成自己的科技使用習慣。

generous.en: She was generous enough to share her notes with the whole group.
generous.zh: 她很大方地把筆記分享給整個小組。

gentle.en: A gentle breeze made the afternoon walk more comfortable.
gentle.zh: 柔和的微風讓午後散步更舒服。

gently.en: Place the glass gently on the table to avoid damage.
gently.zh: 請輕輕把玻璃杯放在桌上，以免損壞。

geography.en: Geography helps students understand how people interact with different environments.
geography.zh: 地理幫助學生了解人類如何與不同環境互動。

gesture.en: A simple gesture can sometimes communicate more than words.
gesture.zh: 一個簡單手勢有時比言語傳達得更多。

get.en: Students get better at writing when they practice regularly.
get.zh: 學生規律練習後，寫作能力會變得更好。

gift.en: The class prepared a small gift for the retiring teacher.
gift.zh: 全班為即將退休的老師準備了一份小禮物。

girl.en: The girl asked a thoughtful question during the science lesson.
girl.zh: 那個女孩在自然課提出了一個有深度的問題。

give.en: Please give one reason to support your answer.
give.zh: 請提供一個理由來支持你的答案。

glad.en: I am glad that we finished the project before the deadline.
glad.zh: 我很高興我們在期限前完成了專題。

glass.en: The laboratory uses thick glass containers for this experiment.
glass.zh: 實驗室在這項實驗中使用厚玻璃容器。

global.en: Climate change is a global issue that affects every region.
global.zh: 氣候變遷是影響各地區的全球性議題。

glove.en: Wear a glove when handling materials that may irritate the skin.
glove.zh: 處理可能刺激皮膚的材料時要戴手套。

go.en: We plan to go to the museum after lunch.
go.zh: 我們計畫午餐後去博物館。

goal.en: Setting a clear goal can make study plans more effective.
goal.zh: 設定明確目標能讓讀書計畫更有效。

god.en: The novel describes how people once believed each god controlled part of nature.
god.zh: 這部小說描述古人如何相信每位神祇掌管自然的一部分。

gold.en: The museum displayed a small gold object from ancient times.
gold.zh: 博物館展示了一件古代的小型金製品。

good.en: Good preparation can reduce stress before an important exam.
good.zh: 充分準備可以減少重要考試前的壓力。

government.en: The government announced new measures to improve public transportation.
government.zh: 政府宣布了改善大眾運輸的新措施。

grade.en: Her grade improved after she changed her study habits.
grade.zh: 她改變讀書習慣後，成績進步了。

gradual.en: The improvement was gradual but continued throughout the semester.
gradual.zh: 進步雖然緩慢，但整個學期都持續著。

gradually.en: The sky gradually became brighter as the sun rose.
gradually.zh: 隨著太陽升起，天空逐漸變亮。

graduate.en: She hopes to graduate with strong skills in science and English.
graduate.zh: 她希望畢業時具備扎實的科學與英文能力。

grain.en: Farmers store dry grain in large containers after harvest.
grain.zh: 農民收成後把乾燥穀物存放在大型容器中。

grammar.en: Good grammar helps make your writing easier to understand.
grammar.zh: 良好的文法能讓文章更容易理解。

grandfather.en: My grandfather enjoys telling stories about his school days.
grandfather.zh: 我祖父喜歡講他學生時代的故事。

grandmother.en: My grandmother taught me how to prepare this traditional dish.
grandmother.zh: 我祖母教我如何準備這道傳統料理。

grant.en: The university offered a grant to support the research project.
grant.zh: 大學提供一筆補助金支持這項研究。

grass.en: The grass grew quickly after several days of rain.
grass.zh: 連續幾天下雨後，草長得很快。

great.en: The new library is a great place for quiet study.
great.zh: 新圖書館是安靜讀書的好地方。

green.en: The school added more green spaces around the campus.
green.zh: 學校在校園周圍增加了更多綠地。

greet.en: Students stood at the entrance to greet visiting teachers.
greet.zh: 學生站在入口迎接來訪教師。

ground.en: The heavy box was placed carefully on the ground.
ground.zh: 那個沉重的箱子被小心放到地上。

group.en: Each group must present its findings to the class.
group.zh: 每個小組都必須向全班報告研究結果。

grow.en: Plants grow faster when they receive enough light and water.
grow.zh: 植物得到足夠陽光和水分時會長得更快。

growth.en: The chart shows steady growth in online learning over five years.
growth.zh: 圖表顯示線上學習在五年間穩定成長。

guess.en: Try to guess the word's meaning from the surrounding sentence.
guess.zh: 試著從周圍句子猜出這個單字的意思。

guest.en: A guest speaker will visit our class next Monday.
guest.zh: 下星期一會有一位客座講者來我們班。

guide.en: The guide explained the history of the old building clearly.
guide.zh: 導覽員清楚介紹了這棟老建築的歷史。

habit.en: Reading every day can become a useful study habit.
habit.zh: 每天閱讀可以成為有用的學習習慣。

hair.en: Her hair was still wet after swimming practice.
hair.zh: 游泳練習後，她的頭髮還是濕的。

half.en: Only half of the students finished the task on time.
half.zh: 只有一半學生準時完成任務。

hall.en: The graduation ceremony will be held in the main hall.
hall.zh: 畢業典禮會在大禮堂舉行。

hand.en: Please raise your hand if you know the answer.
hand.zh: 如果你知道答案，請舉手。

handle.en: Students must handle laboratory equipment with great care.
handle.zh: 學生操作實驗室設備時必須非常小心。

happen.en: Unexpected problems can happen even with careful planning.
happen.zh: 即使仔細規劃，仍可能發生意外問題。

happy.en: She felt happy after completing the difficult assignment.
happy.zh: 完成困難的作業後，她感到很開心。

hard.en: The team worked hard to finish the project before Friday.
hard.zh: 團隊努力工作，在星期五前完成專題。

hardly.en: I could hardly hear the speaker because the room was noisy.
hardly.zh: 房間太吵，我幾乎聽不到講者說話。

harm.en: Too much noise can harm concentration during study.
harm.zh: 過多噪音會傷害讀書時的專注力。

harmful.en: Some chemicals are harmful if they enter the water supply.
harmful.zh: 有些化學物質若進入供水系統會造成危害。

hat.en: He wore a hat to protect himself from the strong sun.
hat.zh: 他戴帽子來避免強烈陽光直射。

hate.en: I hate wasting time when a problem can be solved simply.
hate.zh: 如果問題可以簡單解決，我很討厭浪費時間。

have.en: We have enough information to begin the next stage.
have.zh: 我們已經有足夠資訊可以開始下一階段。

he.en: He checked the final answer twice before submitting the test.
he.zh: 他交卷前把最後答案檢查了兩次。

head.en: She turned her head when someone called her name.
head.zh: 有人叫她名字時，她轉過頭去。

health.en: Regular sleep is important for both physical and mental health.
health.zh: 規律睡眠對身心健康都很重要。

healthy.en: A healthy routine should include enough sleep and exercise.
healthy.zh: 健康的作息應包含充足睡眠與運動。

hear.en: Could you speak louder so everyone can hear you?"
hear.zh: 你可以說大聲一點，讓每個人都聽得到嗎？

heart.en: Exercise can help keep the heart strong and healthy.
heart.zh: 運動有助於維持心臟強健與健康。

heat.en: Dark surfaces absorb more heat under direct sunlight.
heat.zh: 深色表面在陽光直射下會吸收更多熱能。

heavy.en: The heavy rain caused flooding in several low areas.
heavy.zh: 大雨造成幾個低窪地區淹水。

height.en: The students measured the height of each plant every week.
height.zh: 學生每週測量每株植物的高度。

help.en: Clear notes can help you review more efficiently before exams.
help.zh: 清楚的筆記能幫助你在考前更有效率地複習。

helpful.en: The teacher gave helpful feedback on my first draft.
helpful.zh: 老師針對我的初稿提供了有幫助的回饋。

her.en: The teacher returned her report with several useful comments.
her.zh: 老師把她的報告退回，並附上幾則實用評語。

here.en: Please write your name here before submitting the form.
here.zh: 提交表格前請在這裡寫上你的名字。

high.en: The mountain road reaches a high point near the old temple.
high.zh: 這條山路在老廟附近到達較高的位置。

highly.en: This study method is highly effective for reviewing vocabulary.
highly.zh: 這種讀書方法對複習單字非常有效。

hill.en: We climbed the hill to get a better view of the city.
hill.zh: 我們爬上山丘，以便看見更好的城市景色。

him.en: The teacher asked him to explain how he solved the problem.
him.zh: 老師請他說明自己如何解決這個問題。

his.en: His explanation was clear enough for everyone to understand.
his.zh: 他的解釋很清楚，大家都能理解。

history.en: History helps us understand how societies change over time.
history.zh: 歷史幫助我們了解社會如何隨時間改變。

hit.en: The ball hit the wall and bounced back toward us.
hit.zh: 球撞到牆後彈回我們這邊。

hold.en: The school will hold a science fair next month.
hold.zh: 學校下個月會舉辦科展。

hole.en: The workers repaired a large hole in the road.
hole.zh: 工人修補了道路上的一個大洞。

holiday.en: We visited our relatives during the long holiday.
holiday.zh: 我們在長假期間拜訪了親戚。

home.en: I reviewed my notes at home after school.
home.zh: 放學後我在家複習筆記。

hope.en: We hope the weather will improve before the trip.
hope.zh: 我們希望旅行前天氣會好轉。

hospital.en: The new hospital provides emergency care around the clock.
hospital.zh: 這家新醫院全天候提供急診照護。

hot.en: The classroom became too hot after the air conditioner stopped.
hot.zh: 冷氣停止運作後，教室變得太熱。

hotel.en: The hotel is within walking distance of the train station.
hotel.zh: 這家旅館距離火車站很近，走路可到。

hour.en: The meeting lasted for nearly an hour this afternoon.
hour.zh: 今天下午的會議持續了將近一小時。

house.en: The old house was renovated without changing its original style.
house.zh: 這棟老房子在保留原本風格的情況下完成整修。

how.en: The experiment shows how temperature affects the reaction speed.
how.zh: 這個實驗顯示溫度如何影響反應速度。

however.en: The first plan was cheaper; however, the second was more reliable.
however.zh: 第一個方案較便宜；然而，第二個更可靠。

huge.en: The project required a huge amount of time and cooperation.
huge.zh: 這項專題需要大量時間與合作。

human.en: Human activity can strongly affect natural environments.
human.zh: 人類活動會大幅影響自然環境。

hundred.en: More than one hundred students joined the school event.
hundred.zh: 超過一百名學生參加了學校活動。

hungry.en: I felt hungry after practicing basketball for two hours.
hungry.zh: 打了兩小時籃球後，我覺得很餓。

hunt.en: Some animals hunt at night when the temperature is cooler.
hunt.zh: 有些動物在夜晚較涼時獵食。

hurry.en: There is no need to hurry if we follow the schedule.
hurry.zh: 只要照著行程走，就不需要急。

hurt.en: She hurt her knee while running during sports practice.
hurt.zh: 她在體育練習跑步時傷到膝蓋。
